services.name: Island Jet Ski of Vermont
services.desc: This year, don’t just visit Vermont-experience it from the water with Island Jet Ski Boat Tours & Rentals. Swap the slopes for waves and enjoy a new kind of adventure on Lake Whitingham in Southern Vermont. From high-speed jet ski thrills to relaxing pontoon and boat rentals, Island Jet Ski has everything you need to turn your Vermont getaway into an unforgettable lake escape. Perfect for couples, families, or groups, our boat tours deliver the best views, fresh air, and lasting memories. We’ve proudly operated in the Wilmington, Vermont area for more than 10 years, offering a mobile and flexible outdoor experience.
